user_story: As a user, I want to upload a file so that I can share documents easily. Additionally, I want to download a file provided on the page for my use. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I upload a file using the input with id 'uploadFile', I should be able to see the file listed in the interface. 2. When I click the 'Download' button with id 'downloadButton', the download should start successfully.
